name: Claap
description:
Most connectors hand Claude raw transcripts to wade through. Claap hands it answers.

Claap records your calls, syncs your emails and labels every customer signal into structured AI fields, so Claude reasons over your full sales context instead of a slice of it.

Ask what happened. "Summarise yesterday's demo with Contoso and list the next steps." Claude reads the AI summary, not the whole transcript.

Ask what is being said. Search every call semantically or by keyword, already labelled by pain point, objection, feature request and competitor mention.

Ask about the pipeline. Query deals, companies and contacts with their CRM fields, or pull a saved view (MEDDIC, SPICED, objection trackers) so the answer comes back in the shape your team already works in.

Ask across email too, so deal context is not limited to what was said out loud.

Then act on it. Create AI fields and views, update contacts, and move a deal's stage, amount or owner, written straight through to your connected HubSpot.

Because answers are read from Claap's structured fields rather than inferred from raw recordings, they come back sourced and consistent instead of re-derived on every run.

Works with the Claap workspace you already have. Every call is scoped to one workspace and to your own permissions, so Claude sees exactly what you see in Claap. Private spaces stay private.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Claap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Claap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.claap.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Claap MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Claap lists 57 MCP tools, including create_admin_automation, create_company_field, create_company_view, create_contact, create_contact_view, create_deal_field, create_deal_view, create_recording_field, create_recording_view, get_company, get_company_view, and get_contact.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Claap?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Claap in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Claap requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Claap is developed by Claap. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
